articles.title: The Man Who Teaches Pottery Out of a Bomb Shelter
articles.mainIdea: The Man Who Teaches Pottery Out of a Bomb Shelter
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: The Man Who Teaches Pottery Out of a Bomb Shelter. At least three times a week, Oleksandr Ryabov climbs into a bomb shelter in the southern Ukrainian city of Bashtanka and waits for his students to arrive. Many of them are displaced from nearby cities occupied or ravaged by Russian forces. The two-hour sessions sometimes run long, as the class waits for the all-clear signal.
